question: What is the ratio of net income of d10 to d1 group of Singapore in 2015?
query: SELECT   CASE     WHEN t.category = 'd10' THEN t.income_net     ELSE t.income_net   END / CASE     WHEN t.category = 'd10' THEN t.income_net     ELSE t.income_net   END AS ratio FROM country_income AS t WHERE   t.country = 'Singapore' AND t.year = 2015 AND t.category IN ('d10', 'd1');
